title: Fix one reproduced bug
goal: Make the named bug reproduction pass without weakening the existing suite.

streams.summary: Reproduce the bug on the baseline, then fix it inside the owned path.
acceptance: On the baseline commit the reproduction command exits non-zero for the expected reason, and the failure is not an import error or a missing dependency.
The same reproduction command exits 0 on the candidate commit.
The existing regression command exits 0 on the candidate commit.
